cases.name: Diana Marie Lukosius
cases.about: She was a dental hygienist. I sent a Facebook message to her brother Roger Lukosius on 6/5/2021 asking for a photo.
cases.narrative: She was driving home from a party when he allegedly forced her off the road and severely beat her. She died two days later.
